Computer Science, BS

Computer Science, BS

Today’s computing technology touches every aspect of our lives. Our computer science program prepares you for success in a wide range of industries, including tech, finance, healthcare, and gaming. Students gain a strong foundation in mathematics, algorithmic principles, and computer science theory. In addition, students get practical application experience through a senior capstone design project. Graduates of this degree are ready to design and develop the software and computer systems of the future.

          Points of Pride

Empowered by Innovation

A comprehensive computer science education prepares you for success in vaious industries, including tech, finance, healthcare, and gaming.

Maximizing Potential

In 2022 Amazon announced a $1.5M gift to this program, providing assistance to students, particularly those from underrepresented populations.

Personalized Support

          Featured Faculty

          See the Computer Science Faculty Page

Dr. Sara Farag

Program Chair

Dr. Farag has a doctoral degree in computer science and computer graphics from Deakin University in Melbourne, Australia. After joining Swinburne University’s online team as an education technologist and web developer, she became a course coordinator and lecturer for web design courses there. 

                Dr. Farag's Full Bio

Alfred Nehme

Faculty

Alfred Nehme received his B.S. degree from The Ohio State University and M.S. degree in Computer Science from the University of Wisconsin – Madison. Prior to joining Bellevue College he worked for 20 years in the software engineering industry.

Computer Science Student Advisory Board

The CS Student Advisory Board is a group of students within the Bachelors in Computer Science Program dedicated to promoting and building the Computer Science Community at Bellevue College.

The club's mission is to facilitate student engagement and community building; acting as a liaison between the students and faculty to promote positive growth within the BC CS community.

Computer Science, BS: Data Science Emphasis

Bachelor Degree

Bachelor of Science Degree in Computer Science with an emphasis in Data Science from Bellevue College meets the critical and pervasive demand for rigorously trained computer science professionals specializing in Data Science. This degree program will prepare graduates to use mathematics, statistics, artificial intelligence algorithms, scientific computing, and systems to analyze, design, and implement data-driven systems, enabling them to derive insights and solutions from complex datasets of varying size and complexity.

First-Year Applicants



Apply as a First-Year Applicant if you have completed 40 or fewer transferable college credits. First-Year applicants are not required to complete prerequisite courses before applying. Instead, you must be eligible to enroll in the following courses through placement, prior coursework, or qualifying exam scores:




MATH& 151 Calculus I; Placement by assessment or MATH& 142 with a C- or better, or AP score of 2 or higher on AB or BC exam.



ENGL& 101 English Composition I; Placement by assessment or ENGL 092 or ENGL 093 with C- or better.








Transfer Applicants (Most Common Option)



Apply as a Transfer Applicant if you have completed more than 40 transferable college credits or already hold a bachelor’s degree. Transfer applicants must complete the following prerequisite courses (or equivalent transfer courses). Prerequisite courses may be in progress at the time of application but must be completed before the start of your first quarter.




ENGL& 101 – English Composition I



MATH& 151 – Calculus I



MATH& 152 – Calculus II



CS 210 – Fundamentals of Computer Science I



CS 211 – Fundamentals of Computer Science II (with a C (2.0) grade or higher)



5–6 credits of one laboratory science:

PHYS 121



Biology with lab



Chemistry with lab






Transfer Credit & Equivalencies



If you’ve completed coursework at another institution or earned college credit through AP, IB, Cambridge, or other qualifying exams, use Bellevue College’s Transfer Evaluation System (TES) and Exam Credit Guide to see how your coursework may transfer. If you have questions about whether a specific course meets a BSCS prerequisite requirement, please contact the program at cs@bellevuecollege.edu.












International Students: The BSCS is not a fully online program. Because most courses include in-person or hybrid instruction, the program is eligible for F-1 international students.



All international applicants must submit proof of English language proficiency as defined by the the International Education (IE) department by the application deadline. Please see the International Education office’s website for details.
rules.reason: Applicant category depends on completed transferable credits or prior degree; placement, in-progress work and transfer equivalencies require review.

bullets: First-year applicants need placement eligibility for Calculus I and English Composition I; completed prerequisite courses are not required before applying.
Transfer-pathway prerequisites may be in progress when applying, but must be completed before the first quarter. Select Before enrollment to review that named-course subset.
A 5–6-credit lab science, equivalencies, placement and other application conditions remain unresolved. The source explicitly gives CS 211 a C/2.0 minimum; other grade minima are not invented.
The published Winter2027 priority deadline is November13,2026. Its final-deadline year conflicts with the entry term; verify final dates directly.
